performance_descriptions_en.slip_lubricity: N/A

performance_descriptions_en.soft_touch: Highly resilient beads can modify tactile properties and create a unique surface touch.

performance_descriptions_zh.soft_touch: 高彈性微珠可調節觸感特性，創造獨特的表面膚感觸覺。

application_fields_en: Industrial coatings (including plastic, vinyl and leather); architectural wall and trim paints; wood coatings; printing inks and OPV's (including flexo and gravure); powder coatings; interior and exterior can and container coatings; soft touch coatings; floor coatings; visual effects.
application_fields_zh: 工業塗料（包括塑料、乙烯基與皮革）；建築牆面與裝飾漆；木器塗料；印刷油墨與過油（包括柔版與凹版）；粉末塗料；罐裝與容器內外部塗料；觸感塗料；地板塗料；視覺效果。
interior_exterior_en: Interior and exterior can and container coatings
interior_exterior_zh: 罐裝與容器內外部塗料
suggested_use_level_en: 2.0-10.0% (higher amounts when greater tactile effects are desired) (on total formula weight)
suggested_use_level_zh: 2.0-10.0%（若需要更佳的觸感效果可添加更高劑量）（佔總配方重量）

performance_descriptions_en.scratch_abrasion_resistance: Highly resilient spherical polyurethane beads that improve scratch, mar, and abrasion resistance.
performance_descriptions_en.slip_lubricity: N/A
performance_descriptions_en.texture_structure: Virtually indestructible elastic particles that distort when disturbed by physical force and return to original shape. Provides different tactile effects ranging from satiny smooth to rubbery to leathery.
performance_descriptions_en.soft_touch: Highly resilient beads can modify tactile properties and create a unique surface touch.

performance_descriptions_zh.scratch_abrasion_resistance: 高彈性球形聚氨酯微珠，可提升耐刮擦、耐磨與耐刮傷性。
performance_descriptions_zh.slip_lubricity: N/A
performance_descriptions_zh.texture_structure: 幾乎不可磨損的彈性粒子，在受到外力作用時會變形，並在外力撤除後回復原始形狀。提供從絲綢般光滑到橡膠感或皮革感等多種不同的觸感效果。
performance_descriptions_zh.soft_touch: 高彈性微珠可調節觸感特性，創造獨特的表面膚感觸覺。

recommended_system_type_en: Water based and solvent based coatings.
recommended_system_type_zh: 水性與溶劑型塗料。
application_fields_en: Industrial coatings (including plastic, metal and leather); architectural wall and trim paints; stains, sealers and varnishes; wood coatings; printing inks and OPV's (including flexo and gravure); powder coatings; coil coatings.
application_fields_zh: 工業塗料（包括塑料、金屬與皮革）；建築牆面與裝飾漆；色漆、密封劑與清漆；木器塗料；印刷油墨與過油（包括柔版與凹版）；粉末塗料；卷材塗料。

performance_descriptions_en.scratch_abrasion_resistance: Tough, high molecular weight polymer imparts burnish and abrasion resistance.
performance_descriptions_en.matting_gloss_control: Provides consistent gloss reduction with no effect on coating viscosity. Density (0.89) ideal for solvent based systems. For more efficient matting with a fine microtexture, try PropylTex 325S/270S.
performance_descriptions_en.slip_lubricity: Imparts anti-slip properties.
performance_descriptions_en.texture_structure: Adds texture in low bake (Low E) powder coatings.

performance_descriptions_zh.scratch_abrasion_resistance: 堅韌的高分子量聚合物能賦予抗拋光與耐磨損性能。
performance_descriptions_zh.matting_gloss_control: 提供一致的消光效果，且對塗料黏度無影響。密度（0.89）非常適合溶劑型系統。如需使用細微織紋進行更高效消光，可嘗試 PropylTex 325S/270S。
performance_descriptions_zh.slip_lubricity: 賦予防滑特性。
performance_descriptions_zh.texture_structure: 在低溫烘烤（Low E）粉末塗料中增加織紋。

performance_descriptions_en.scratch_abrasion_resistance: Tough, high molecular weight polymer imparts burnish and abrasion resistance. Particle density optimized to essentially eliminate flotation or settling in most water based systems.
performance_descriptions_en.matting_gloss_control: Finely micronized densified polypropylene for consistent matting and gloss control with superior in-can stability in water based paints, coatings and inks. Efficient gloss reduction from satin to matte finish. Improves burnish resistance vs. silica mattifiers. For more efficient matting with a fine microtexture, try PropylTex 325HD/270HD.
performance_descriptions_en.slip_lubricity: Imparts anti-slip properties.
performance_descriptions_en.texture_structure: N/A

performance_descriptions_zh.scratch_abrasion_resistance: 堅韌的高分子量聚合物能賦予抗拋光與耐磨損性能。優化粒子密度，在大多數水性系統中基本上能消除浮粉或沉降問題。
performance_descriptions_zh.matting_gloss_control: 細微粉化的緻密聚丙烯，可在水性油漆、塗料和油墨中提供一致的消光與光澤控制，並具有優異的罐內穩定性。能提供從緞面（半光）到全消光效果的高效消光。與二氧化矽消光劑相比，能改善抗拋光性能。如需利用細微織紋進行更高效的消光，可嘗試 PropylTex 325HD/270HD。
performance_descriptions_zh.slip_lubricity: 賦予防滑特性。
performance_descriptions_zh.texture_structure: N/A
